latest_release.body:
[[简体中文]](https://sun-panel-doc.enianteam.com/zh_cn/update/update_log.html) | [English]

> [!CAUTION] 
> 
> 1. Before upgrading from the Docker version `v1.3.0` or earlier to this version, please read the [Update Instructions](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/discussions/98) first.
> 2. If you want to view the Docker status in the container, add the following when mounting: `-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock` (Some devices may not support this.)
> 3. If any exception occurs after updating, please try to force refresh the page (ctrl+shift+R). If it cannot be solved, you can try clearing the browser cache (ctrl+shift+del).

> [!WARNING]
> Must Read Before Upgrading to the Official V2
>
> - You can upgrade directly to v2 without losing data. However, to avoid unexpected issues, it is recommended to first export a backup package from V1 or manually back up your mount directories.
> - To roll back to v1 after upgrading, see [Roll back from V2 to V1](https://doc.sun-panel.top/faq/faq.html#v2_rollback_v1).
> - For more details, see the [Update Instructions and Version Notes](https://doc.sun-panel.top/faq/faq.html).

> Thanks to everyone who took part in the early development and testing of v2 micro apps: `@Madrays`, `@yumo`, `@xx77xx`, `@xiaodong`, `@潘潘`, `@ddapan`...
>
> Thanks to [`@liteyais`](https://appstore.sun-panel.top/author/17) for the icon and layout design, and for developing several high-quality micro apps.
>
> Thanks to **[@every app developer](https://appstore.sun-panel.top/)** in the app store for your support and contributions.
>
> Thanks to everyone who participated in testing and shared suggestions and bug reports.

### 🏠 Brand-New V2 Architecture {#v2-architecture}

- **[New]** Redesigned navigation page layout: supports mixing cards of different sizes (1x1 / 1x2 / 2x1 / 2x2 / 2x4 / 1x screen width) and cross-group drag and drop, with a layout perfectly adapted to mobile devices.
- **[New]** Improved first-screen loading speed, as well as theme and desktop widget **rounded-corner** styles.
- **[New]** Added more languages on top of Chinese and English: Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, French, and Spanish.
- **[New]** Improved Docker card status display, supports 2x2-style cards and shows real-time container network status.
- **[New]** System status is now implemented as a micro-app widget.

### 🧩 Micro Apps / Widgets {#v2-micro-app}

- **[New]** Brand-new micro app / widget framework: flexible installation, uninstallation, clearing data, checking for updates, and version upgrades, with quick launch support for some apps.
- **[New]** App store integration: a wide range of micro apps can be installed from the store.

### 🎬 Video Wallpapers {#v2-video-wallpaper}

- **[New]** Upload any video as your background wallpaper to make your navigation page **cooler** and never boring.

### 🌐 Smart Network Selection <Badge type="warning" text="BETA" /> {#v2-smart-network}

- **[New]** Custom matching-rule support.
    - How it works: Each line is a rule group. Rules are matched line by line against the address used to access the navigation page. Once a group matches, its rules are applied to the addresses under the icon cards (internal addresses and all custom addresses). Clicking an icon opens the first successfully matched address; if none match, the default address is used.

### 🔗 Custom Card Addresses {#v2-custom-address}

- **Scenario 1**: In environments with multiple internal network segments, combine with **Smart Network Selection** to automatically determine which address to open based on the address used to access the navigation page.
- **Scenario 2**: Can be used like multiple folders — right-click an icon to see all configured addresses, and open each one in this window, a new window, or an in-page popup (iframe, requires support from the third-party site).

发布程序的流程说明： 修改 `assets\version` 版本号。 ```sh # 提交代码，打标签 git tag v1.3.2-beta24-02-02 # 推送到 pro 远程库 git push pro --tag # 编译 # 有新标签docker版本会自动在 github action 编译 # 二进制版本，需要将代码推到主库，并且在虚拟机中找到项目目录和编译的镜像，并拉取标签，启动容器并进去拉取代码 # 虚拟机编译 git pull --tag # 注意切换到分支要编译的分支 chmod +x ./build && ./build -r # 编译成功后下载各种二进制文件上传到github ``` [[ 简体中文 ]](https://doc.sun-panel.top/zh_cn/) | [[ English ]](https://doc.sun-panel.top/)

![](./doc/images/main-dark.png) > [!IMPORTANT] > In order to maintain the livelihood, the author added some [`PRO`] (https://pro.sun-panel.top) function, so the project temporarily entered a closed source state.; At present, the latest version of the open source is `v1.3.0`, [Please see the latest version of closed source](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/releases).; When the modular technology is developed, the separation of the PRO and the programs will be opened again, and the closed source will have no effect on ordinary users.; Let's look forward to open source again, and at the same time, we are welcome to supervise and review the security of the program. > > 作者为了维持生计，增加了一些 [`PRO`](https://pro.sun-panel.top) 功能，所以项目暂时进入闭源状态。目前开源最新版本为`v1.3.0`，[闭源最新版本请查看](https://github.com/hslr-s/sun-panel/releases)。待开发出模块化技术，然后对PRO和主程序进行分离会再次开源，闭源对普通用户没有任何影响。我们一起期待再次开源吧，同时也欢迎各位大佬对程序的安全性进行监督和审查。 ## 😎 Features - 🍉 Clean interface, powerful functionality, low resource consumption - 🍊 Easy to use, visual operation, zero-code usage - 🍠 One-click switch between internal and external network modes - 🍵 Supports Docker deployment (compatible with Arm systems) - 🎪 Supports multi-account isolation - 🎏 Supports viewing system status - 🫙 Supports custom JS, CSS - 🍻 Simple usage without the need to connect to an external database - 🍾 Rich icon styles for free combination, supports [Iconify icon library](https://icon-sets.iconify.design/) - 🚁 Supports opening small windows in the webpage (some third-party websites may block this feature) ## 🖼️ Preview Screenshots **Various styles, freely combined** ![](./doc/images/icon-small-new.png) ![](./doc/images/transparent-info.png) ![](./doc/images/transparent-small.png) ![](./doc/images/solid-color-info.png) ![](./doc/images/full-color-small.jpg) **Built-in small windows** ![](./doc/images/window-ssh.png) ![](./doc/images/window-xunlei.png) ## 🐳 Deployment tutorial [Deployment Tutorial](https://sun-panel-doc.enianteam.com/usage/quick_deploy.html) ## 🍵 Donate > Open-source development is not easy. If you feel that my project has helped you, you are welcome to [donate](./doc/donate.md) or buy me a cup of tea☕ (please leave your nickname or name in the note if possible).
